posts.text: The timelines of delivery do entail it’s a CMO……. No Development here……but certainly indicates that someone values their capabilities and accreditions. The promoter and journalists, both used the CDMO term. Nevertheless……seems we will see improvement in topline (provided existing biz at status quo) and if better margins present, then the company may be inching upwards in value chain. All eyes on follow up orders and q2. Meanwhile, will appreciate guidance from veteran investors.

posts.text: Morepen Labs Bets Big On CDMO! Management Sees 75% Revenue From New Business | Sushil Suri | ET Now Times are a changing? Can a company with a checkered history re-invent itself? lets see it unfold over the next few qtrs……. Morepen Labs 2.0 is a CDMO now…….change happened over 6 months……announcement of a 823 cr CDMO order, followed by a clean USFDA inspection, and swift execution by 58cr delivery by Q1 itself. Claims execution of the order in the next 12 months…….MRR of 60-70. Questions……. who is the big pharma here? Will there be more orders from them?……. or is this a one off (rather unlikely…
